verdict.rationale: Segment's docs list official tracking libraries for C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin (Android) and Swift, and show `analytics.track` usage. The Spec covers formats "across all of Segment's libraries and APIs," and the Public API reference ships a downloadable OpenAPI spec with an "Install and use an SDK" section plus auth, rate-limit, pagination and versioning docs. missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK documentation (install, versioning, maintenance) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
